claim: G31 P4 R3: the generic transport laboratory can preserve a closed native candidate state containing ordinary anonymous Prolog dictionaries by admitting variables only as dictionary tags, encoding a canonically numbered copy, and requiring variant-exact fresh-process reconstruction plus independent cursor and source-hash agreement.
non_claims: No arbitrary nonground state, candidate semantic change, generic transport behavior change, fixture change, model use, Mattermost contact/credential/message, live grant, promotion/activation, universal exactly-once, or complete Soul cognition.
rationale: Attempt 102 established that SWI-Prolog's anonymous dict syntax creates a variable tag even when every state value is closed. Rejecting that idiom conflates representation with semantic openness. Canonical numbering on a copy preserves variable sharing and complete structure, while an explicit tag-only variable audit prevents unresolved state values from crossing the durable boundary.
reading: Retain both controls, P3 closure, P4 authorship assessment/R1 plan, and attempts 101-102. Reread the exact candidate state representation, SWI anonymous-dictionary semantics, durable store and restart obligations, C-064-C-066/C-101-C-104, and S-903-S-905/S-1003-S-1005/S-1101-S-1105.
representation: Audit term_variables(State) by identity against the variable tags collected from every dictionary subterm; fail if any variable is not a dictionary tag. Copy the state, number variables deterministically, and write the canonical quoted ignore-operators form. Persist schema, integer cursor, state term, candidate hash, and transport hash. In the child, read the term, repeat the tag-only variable audit, require variant equality to the decoded canonical form, and require byte-identical canonical re-encoding plus independent cursor/hash checks.
consumer: Prolog owns only safe opaque encoding, exact reconstruction, and mechanical checks. The candidate remains the source of state meaning. PeTTa/MeTTa consumes the typed trial observation and owns qualification. JavaScript freezes and audits evidence but does not interpret candidate state or decide behavior.
falsifiers: A variable outside an anonymous dictionary tag is admitted; sharing or structure changes; canonical re-encoding differs; cursor/hash fields disagree but restart passes; attempt 102 is overwritten; fixture or candidate changes; loopback proceeds after failed reconstruction; or any model, credential, Mattermost, promotion, or activation effect occurs.
scope_review: Change only the native-state carrier/readback and R3 harness/plan references; preserve attempts 101-102; rerun the same generic loopback, severed and native causal trials. No candidate edit, destination-specific transport code, model, Mattermost host/credential/message, Docker mutation, promotion, activation, push, or control change.
rollback: Attempts 101-102 remain immutable. Reverting the tag-safe variant carrier and removing R3 artifacts restores the known groundness mismatch; no external or active state exists.
